# Mint for Google Antigravity

Connect a Mint account to browse projects, retrieve finished 3D assets, and use Mint Modeler to create a static GLB from a prompt or reference images. Mint also offers separate services for worlds, materials, and asset packs.

## Install and connect

Install the plugin with Google Antigravity and sign in to Mint when prompted. The plugin uses OAuth to connect to `https://mcp.mint.gg/mcp`. Review the requested access in the Mint consent screen. You can connect through the Antigravity CLI with the [Mint setup guide](https://mint.gg/guides/connect-mint-to-antigravity).

## Check the connection

1. Ask Antigravity to run Mint's `who_am_i` tool. It should report the connected account and its available capabilities.
2. Ask it to list your active Mint projects with `list_projects`.
3. If the connected account has a finished model, ask for its GLB from the model's artifact manifest.

These checks are read-only and use no Mint Credits. Generation uses Credits from the connected account. Choose the Modeler quality tier and confirm the request before starting paid work.

[Tool reference](https://mcp.mint.gg/docs) · [Access and Credits](https://docs.mint.gg/integrations/mcp) · [Privacy](https://docs.mint.gg/privacy) · [Support](https://docs.mint.gg/support)
